app.title: Wayland desktop for Linux with skeuomorphic design
app.author: FinalDestiny
app.description: A Wayland-based desktop environment for Linux featuring a skeuomorphic design aesthetic.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and build the application on a recent Linux distro
Run the built executable and verify the GUI loads without errors
Measure startup time from command to window ready state
Check that basic window management actions (move, resize, close) work
